description: Resolve an MCP server name, catalog id, GitHub repository URL, or what a config file names (an npm or PyPI package, a container image, a hosted https address) to the real registry entry. If there is no exact match, returns the closest real names so look-alikes and invented names can be caught. No account needed.

identifier.description: e.g. io.github.github/github-mcp-server, @scope/package, pypi:name, docker:owner/image, https://mcp.example.com/mcp (send the bare address, never a key or query string)

name: resolve_identifier
title: Does this tool really exist?
